motif.name: Nibelungs and Mining of Gold
motif.description: Passages of the piano score that match one melody, in levels by how close they are to it. Level 1 is the closest. A run of repeated notes counts as one note. Passages that overlap, or lie within 1 measure of each other, are joined into one; the level is that of the closest.

libretto.text: Das biet’ ich mit mir zum Bund.
libretto.translation: This I offer you, with myself, for the bond.
But of the Niblung hoard
does the tale call you lord?
I almost forgot the treasure;

libretto.text: so schätz’ ich sein müß’ges Gut!
libretto.translation: that is how I value its idle wealth!
